blocks.text: Breadth-First Search (BFS) graph traversal algorithm hai jo graph ke tamam nodes level ba level (satah ba satah) dekhta hai, ek diye gaye node se shuru kar ke (jise aksar root kehte hain). Jin nodes ko abhi dekhna baqi hai un ka hisab rakhne ke liye yeh queue (qataar: jo pehle aaye woh pehle nikle) istemal karta hai.

items: Root node se shuru karein aur use queue mein dalein (enqueue).
Queue se ek node nikalein (dequeue), use process karein, aur us ke tamam na dekhe gaye (unvisited) parosi (neighbors) queue mein dal dein.
Yeh amal queue khali hone tak dohrayein.

blocks.text: Misal: social network graph mein har node ek insaan aur har edge dosti hai. BFS se do logon ke darmiyan sab se chhota raasta (shortest path) dhoonda ja sakta hai, maslan do users ke darmiyan degree of separation (kitne doston ke zariye jure hain).
Complexity: BFS ki time complexity O(V + E) hai, jahan V vertices (nodes) ki tadaad aur E edges ki tadaad hai. Is liye yeh bare graphs dekhne ke liye efficient hai.

blocks.prompt: Root 0, us ke bachche 1, 2, 3, aur pote 4, 5 (1 ke neeche), 6 (2 ke neeche) aur 7 (3 ke neeche) wale tree (Figure 3.8) mein BFS kis tarteeb se nodes dekhta hai?

items: BFS: queue, level ba level; do logon ke darmiyan shortest path; O(V + E).
